Parameterized query cursor.execute("SELECT hashed_password, username FROM users WHERE email = ?", (req.email,)) user = cursor.fetchone() # Constant-time comparison is handled by passlib.verify if not user or not pwd_context.verify(req.password, user["hashed_password"]): raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid email or password") token = create_access_token(data={"sub": user["username"]}) return {"token": token, "message": "Login successful"} except HTTPException: raise except Exception: raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid email or password") @app.post("/set_secret") async def set_secret(req: SecretRequest, current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user)): #
